purpose: Sole authorized path from paper intraday trading to live rupees. Written before any paper session data exists. Edits after data collection begins require a dated amendment block below; silent edits void the gate.

primary_hypothesis.name: ORB-NIFTYBEES-v1
primary_hypothesis.product: MIS modeled, 1x leverage only, long only
primary_hypothesis.rules: Opening range = high/low of 1-min bars 09:15-09:45 IST. One entry per session: buy stop at range_high + 1 tick, valid until 13:00 IST. Initial stop = range midpoint. Exits: stop hit, or time exit 15:10 IST. Position notional Rs.2,000. No re-entries.
primary_hypothesis.fill_model: Entry at trigger + 1 tick + half-spread; exits at stop/close - half-spread; costs from quantshield/costs.py; blind sessions (feed stale >3min at signal time) take no trade and are excluded from N
primary_hypothesis.freeze_rule: Any parameter change creates ORB-NIFTYBEES-v2 with its own clock starting at zero; v1 continues accruing unchanged. Only ONE arm is ever the primary hypothesis for the gate test.

secondary_arms.discretionary: Operator session tickets, tagged discretionary=true. EXPLORATORY ONLY: excluded from the gate test. If ever promoted to a gate candidate, it becomes a new primary with a fresh 60-session clock and Bonferroni correction for arms tested to date.

benchmark_and_test.benchmark: Same-capital NIFTYBEES buy-and-hold, exposure-adjusted: adjusted_delta_t = strat_ret_t - beta_t * bench_ret_t, where beta_t = fraction of session the strategy held a position
benchmark_and_test.directional_guard: The gate cannot open in an evaluation window where raw buy-and-hold return was negative (a bear window must not flatter a mostly-flat strategy)
benchmark_and_test.test: One-sided bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, on the adjusted daily delta series; gate requires p < 0.05
benchmark_and_test.power_statement: At ~Rs.45-50 daily delta sigma on the paper book, N=60 detects only ~Sharpe 3.5-4 effects. Non-rejection is the EXPECTED outcome and is NOT evidence the strategy 'nearly worked'. This gate exists to protect capital from its operators.
benchmark_and_test.reviewer: Independent written review must concur before the gate is declared open; p-value alone is insufficient

live_pilot_if_gate_opens.funding: Pilot capital is funded separately; the existing CNC book is not unwound to fund the pilot
live_pilot_if_gate_opens.size: Rs.2,000 MIS notional, 1x, max one round trip per session
live_pilot_if_gate_opens.execution: Deterministic executor only (MIS-capable fork of quantshield/live/executor.py with identical guardrail philosophy); orders are placed, sized, and approved by that executor and nothing else; resting SL-M/SL-L stop on the book immediately after any fill; deterministic 15:05/15:12 IST two-stage flatten ladder in code, never dependent on an operator being present
live_pilot_if_gate_opens.promotion_criteria: Net P&L > 2x cumulative transaction costs AND max drawdown < 10% of pilot capital
live_pilot_if_gate_opens.kill_criterion: Cumulative pilot drawdown >= Rs.500 auto-writes data/KILL_INTRADAY; pilot ends; written post-mortem required before any restart
live_pilot_if_gate_opens.compliance_cost: Any recurring compliance cost created by the first live MIS trade is counted against pilot EV in the promotion review

scale_ladder.requires: Pilot promoted on its written criteria; then >=40 further sessions with net > 2x costs and DD < 10% at this size
Prior stage promoted; >=6 months cumulative live evidence; net Sharpe >= 1.5 after all costs including data fees and filing
All prior stages promoted; capital owner sign-off; written risk memo with independent written review; nothing here pre-commits the capital owner to this stage

standing_rules.no_topups: Live account capital frozen at its registered balance plus the pre-registered pilot allocation only, until a stage promotion explicitly allows more
standing_rules.kill_hierarchy: data/KILL halts the live executor and exit-guard actions; data/KILL_INTRADAY halts paper/feed/pilot arms only

verification_tasks_week_one.cost_model: Cross-check quantshield/costs.py against Zerodha's brokerage calculator for Rs.2,000 NIFTYBEES and Rs.2,000 SBIN MIS round trips; record both results here in an amendment block
verification_tasks_week_one.orb_geometry: From 1-min historical backfill: opening-range width distribution, implied cost-in-R per trade, breakeven win-rate/R frontier; recorded here before the first scored session
verification_tasks_week_one.mis_eligibility: Confirm NIFTYBEES MIS eligibility and margin at Zerodha

evidence_context: SEBI FY23: 71% of equity intraday traders lose (80% for frequent). Brazil/Taiwan studies: no learning curve exists at population scale. This project's own validated finding: no signal stack beat equal-weight on daily data with significance.

amendments.note: In-sample cost-geometry replay on official 1-min candles via frozen evaluate_session. NOT the gate test; live paper sessions remain the only gate evidence.

caveats: in-sample single regime slice; no parameter search was run (v1 rules frozen before this replay)
official candles have no intrabar sequencing: same-bar stop ambiguity resolved adversarially
this is plausibility evidence only; the gate counts live paper sessions exclusively

amendments.note: The Kite 09:15 candle open is the pre-open auction print. Across the 132 replay sessions it sits 0.35% above the 09:16 open on average, so the session benchmark recorded a summed return of -38.63% over a window whose first-close to last-close return was -6.99%. The session open for the benchmark is now the 09:15 bar close. Strategy rules and fills are untouched: the replay reproduces 43 triggers, 13 wins, net -141.91 exactly. Records now carry bench_open, bench_close and signal_gap_min.
amendments.old_definition: bench_open = 09:15 candle open; bench_close = last bar close at or before 15:30
amendments.new_definition: bench_open = 09:15 candle close; bench_close = last bar close at or before 15:30
amendments.directional_guard: computed by the scoreboard as buy-and-hold from the first scored session open to the last scored session close, per the registered wording; the earlier sum of session returns is no longer used
amendments.blind_rule: feed gaps are judged up to the entry bar, or up to 13:00 when no entry triggered, per the registered fill_model wording; the earlier implementation judged gaps up to 15:10

amendments.note: Study closed. The live paper test collected 1 of 60 sessions (2026-07-21, untriggered, not blind). The feed job was never scheduled, so no further sessions were recorded. The replay verdict is negative after costs (43 triggers, 13 wins, net -141.91 on 2,000 notional, one-sided bootstrap p = 1.0). The gate never opened and no live pilot ran.

quantshield/costs.py exempted ETF intraday sells from STT. Zerodha charges 0.025% STT on intraday sells of equity ETFs such as NIFTYBEES (only gold, liquid, gilt and some international ETFs are exempt). The constant was set to 0.025% and the replay re-run on the same 132 sessions with the same frozen rules; entries, exits and gross P&L are unchanged.
